newsitem.title: UK: Portugal, Germany lead European cotton-buying.
newsitem.headline: Portugal, Germany lead European cotton-buying.

text.p: A clearer picture of European mill requirements emerged on Wednesday as buying interest in Central Asian cottons remained concentrated in Portugal and Germany, industry sources said.
Fresh enquiry from German mills for Spring and early Summer shipment resulted in a few firm trades and more gaps in raw material requirements are thought to remain unfilled.
Traders in Portugal reported new buying interest but the French market was neglected.
Sources in Italy said the spinners were reluctant to re-enter the market until they received a stronger indication of whether outstanding shipments of Central Asian styles would arrive on time.
Prices for Central Asian Middling 1-3/32" were quoted marginally up at around 75.25 cents per lb. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
